svg.title: KIO and AURA
svg.desc: KIO, the Kernel for Intelligent Orchestration, advances through recorded convergence gates: C-1 context, C-2 registry and C-3 planning are marked done and C-4 response is next. AURA is the memory and reasoning layer designed to pair with it (episodic and semantic memory, beliefs, goals, reasoning traces); integrating it into KIO is gate C-7.
